findings.motion: HB 1264 Election security, Senate third reading, Roll Call 222 (passed 34 yea, 13 nay, 1 excused, 2 not voting)
findings.note: Voted yea on Senate passage of HB 1264. The House-engrossed digest says the bill sets proof-of-residency rules for in-person voter registration at registration agencies, and requires the state to compare the voter registration system with the BMV list of temporary credentials and follow a process when evidence exists that a registered voter is not a citizen.
subjects: proof of citizenship to stay registered
